_why: THE MINTED-MEMBERSHIP LOCK. One entry per feature-set VERSION, featureSet@version → its member slugs, sorted.
catalog/bundles.json carries one row per feature set at its CURRENT version; this file keeps every version ever
written. tooling/ci/assert-bundle-availability.mjs limb H (O-BUNDLE-MEMBER-INSERT-UNLOCKED) fails when a row's
members differ from its version's entry (adding a product means bumping the version), when an entry is edited or
removed (the lock only grows; compared against origin/main's copy), and when a NEW entry names a member that is not
`live` in its register at the commit that adds it.
nikatru_all@1 is written AS IT STANDS: it is `draft`, and fullshot is `preview` in extensions/catalog/extensions.json.
A draft version was never sold, so it is not re-graded; it can never become `sellable` while a member is not live.
Selling the bundle is a v2 whose members are all live.
